gaps: No minimum or maximum age, minimum salary, income-document or salary-transfer requirement is published for this card on any Mobilink Bank or JazzCash source; those fields are left unset rather than estimated.

No minimum balance is published for the JazzCash wallet cards. The wallet's published L0/L1/L2 figures (PKR 200,000 / 1,200,000 / 1,500,000) are MAXIMUM balance caps per wallet level and must not be read as minimum requirements.
The branch-banking SOC is a scanned PDF with no extractable text layer; the card-fee rows were read from a page render of p.4.

requirements.annual_fee_pkr_note: The SOC prices this card as a single line, 'PAY PAK Classic- ATM Card Issuance/ Re-Issuance/ Renewal - PKR. 1,300/- Plus FED/ST', and publishes no separate annual fee; the renewal interval is not stated, so this is the per-issuance/renewal card fee rather than a bank-stated annual charge. Exclusive of FED/ST.
